UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile and personal preferences for the R07 Devotional Agenda

userId.description: Unique user UID from Firebase Auth

leaderName.description: Name of discipleship leader or mentor

groupName.description: Church group or discipleship cell name

R07Week.title: R07Week
R07Week.description: A complete weekly devotional record containing 7 daily entries and weekly spiritual goals

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this week

weekNumber.description: Calendar week number or cycle number

startDate.description: ISO date string for week start (Monday)

endDate.description: ISO date string for week end (Sunday)

motto.description: Spiritual theme or focus of the week

days.description: Array of 7 day devotional journal entries

weeklyEvaluation.description: Weekly review, attendance, and leader summary

PrayerRequest.title: PrayerRequest
PrayerRequest.description: Shared community prayer petition or testimony

prayerCount.description: Count of times community members prayed

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document owned by the user

/users/{userId}/weeks/{weekId}.description: Weekly devotional journal records owned by the user

/prayer_requests/{requestId}.description: Community prayer requests readable by signed-in users and editable by the author or prayer counter
